name: ModelVariant123_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant123_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (rings of sixteen textured quads grow and fade around the slot, a full-screen flash fades and up to 96 quads rise from the command's slot part and cross to the other slot); for a non-negative request it selects the 0x2E-byte command row at gModelVariant123_aConfigs indexed by the request and packs the textures at gModelVariant123_aImages, otherwise it runs one frame and reports the hit (1), the end (2) or a still-moving entry; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-140 images build the same source with VERSION_FRENCH and GRAPHICS_DEFAULT_HEIGHT 256. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
